body: QWEN CHAT API DEMO DISCORD It is widely recognized that continuously scaling both data size and model size can lead to significant improvements in model intelligence. However, the research and industry community has limited experience in effectively scaling extremely large models, whether they are dense or Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) models. Many critical details regarding this scaling process were only disclosed with the recent release of DeepSeek V3. Concurrently, we are developing Qwen2.
summaryZh: 通义千问发布Qwen2.5-Max，深入探索超大规模混合专家（MoE）模型的智能上限。文章探讨了在持续扩展数据和模型规模过程中积累的技术经验，并推动了行业对超大模型扩展细节的认知。原始信息显示：QWEN CHAT API DEMO DISCORD It is widely recognized that continuously scaling both data size and model size can lead to significant improvements in model intelligence. However, the research and industry community has limited experience in effectively scaling extremely large models, whether they are dense or Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) models. Many critical detail。该消息由Qwen · 通义千问发布，主题为“Qwen2.5-Max: Exploring the Intelligence of Large-scale MoE Model”。其重要性主要体现在：Qwen2.5-Max大型MoE模型的发布展示了通义千问在超大规模混合专家模型扩展方面的技术探索。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
